description: This file contains data transfer objects (DTOs), request models, and class definitions related to 'Section4' features of a data asset management system, including site profiles, WWTS process streams, chemical raw materials, chemical SDS, lab data configurations, and water process configurations.

classes.name: SiteProfileDto
classes.description: DTO representing a site profile with key identifying fields and metadata.

classes.name: CreateSiteProfileRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new site profile, requiring site ID, creator, and correlation ID.

classes.name: UpdateSiteProfileRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating an existing site profile, requiring site ID, modifier, and correlation ID.

classes.name: WwtsProcessStreamDto
classes.description: DTO for WWTS process stream configuration, including identification, site, stream name, and metadata.

classes.name: CreateWwtsProcessStreamRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a WWTS process stream, requiring site ID, stream name, creator, and correlation ID.

classes.name: UpdateWwtsProcessStreamRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating a WWTS process stream, requiring site ID, stream name, modifier, and correlation ID.

classes.name: ChemicalRawMaterialDto
classes.description: DTO for chemical raw material configuration, including chemical name and metadata.

classes.name: CreateChemicalRawMaterialRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a chemical raw material, requiring site ID, chemical name, creator, and correlation ID.

classes.name: UpdateChemicalRawMaterialRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating a chemical raw material, requiring site ID, chemical name, modifier, and correlation ID.

classes.name: ChemicalSdsDto
classes.description: DTO for chemical SDS (Safety Data Sheet) details, with identification and metadata.

classes.name: CreateChemicalSdsRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a chemical SDS entry, requiring site ID, chemical name, creator, and correlation ID.

classes.name: UpdateChemicalSdsRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating a chemical SDS entry, requiring site ID, chemical name, modifier, and correlation ID.

classes.name: LabDataConfigurationDto
classes.description: DTO for lab data configurations, including configuration name and metadata.

classes.name: CreateLabDataConfigurationRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a lab data configuration, requiring site ID, configuration name, creator, and correlation ID.

classes.name: UpdateLabDataConfigurationRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating a lab data configuration, requiring site ID, configuration name, modifier, and correlation ID.

classes.name: WaterProcessConfigurationDto
classes.description: DTO for water process configurations, including configuration name and metadata.

classes.name: CreateWaterProcessConfigurationRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a water process configuration, requiring site ID, configuration name, creator, and correlation ID.

classes.name: UpdateWaterProcessConfigurationRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating a water process configuration, requiring site ID, configuration name, modifier, and correlation ID.
